# Salesforce
> Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, helping organizations unify AI, data, apps, and Customer 360 to drive growth and service.

Salesforce provides cloud software for sales, service, marketing, commerce, analytics, integration, and application development, with extensive product documentation, developer resources, APIs, learning content, and trust information.

## Product Documentation
- [Sales Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/ca/sales/): CRM platform for managing leads, opportunities, forecasting, and sales productivity.
- [Service Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/ca/service/): Customer service platform for case management, omnichannel support, and automation.
- [Marketing Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/ca/marketing/): Marketing platform for engagement, personalization, journeys, and campaign orchestration.
- [Commerce Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/ca/commerce/): Digital commerce platform for B2C and B2B storefronts and operations.
- [Data Cloud](https://www.salesforce.com/ca/data/): Unified customer data platform for harmonization, activation, and AI-ready profiles.
- [Platform](https://www.salesforce.com/ca/platform/): Low-code and pro-code application platform for automation, apps, and extensibility.
- [Customer 360](https://www.salesforce.com/ca/customer360/): Unified view of customer data, workflows, and engagement across Salesforce products.

## Help and Product Docs
- [Salesforce Help](https://help.salesforce.com/): Central help portal for product documentation, setup, and feature guidance.
- [Release Notes](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=release-notes.salesforce_release_notes.htm&type=5): Official release notes for Salesforce platform and cloud products.
- [Known Issues](https://issues.salesforce.com/): Public tracker for product bugs, incidents, and issue status.
- [Trailhead Help](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.trailhead.htm&type=5): Help resources for Trailhead learning and credentials.
- [Success Center](https://help.salesforce.com/successcenter): Best practices, adoption guidance, and customer success resources.
- [Accessibility](https://www.salesforce.com/company/legal/accessibility/): Accessibility information, commitments, and product support resources.

## Developer Platform
- [Salesforce Developers](https://developer.salesforce.com/): Main developer portal for platform docs, tools, APIs, and community resources.
- [Developer Documentation](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs): Entry point for Salesforce developer guides and technical references.
- [Platform APIs](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/apis): Overview of Salesforce APIs for data, metadata, events, and integrations.
- [App Development](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/app-development): Resources for building custom apps on the Salesforce platform.
- [Lightning Platform](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/lightning-platform): Tools and guidance for low-code and enterprise app development.
- [DevOps Center](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/devops): Resources for release management, environments, and deployment workflows.
- [Salesforce CLI](https://developer.salesforce.com/tools/salesforcecli): Command-line tools for development, automation, and org management.

## API Reference
- [REST API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/): Reference for accessing Salesforce data and metadata over REST.
- [SOAP API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api.meta/api/): Reference for enterprise and partner SOAP-based integrations.
- [Bulk API 2.0 and Bulk API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_asynch.meta/api_asynch/): High-volume data ingest and extraction APIs for large datasets.
- [Metadata API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/): API for managing customizations, components, and deployments.
- [Tooling API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_tooling.meta/api_tooling/): API for development tools, metadata inspection, and automation.
- [Streaming API Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_streaming.meta/api_streaming/): Pub/sub and event-driven integration for real-time notifications.
- [GraphQL API Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/graphql/guide/): Query Salesforce data with GraphQL for efficient client applications.
- [Pub/Sub API Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/): gRPC-based API for event publishing and subscription at scale.

## Development Frameworks
- [Lightning Web Components](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/component-library/documentation/en/lwc): Modern web component framework for Salesforce UI development.
- [Apex Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.apexcode.meta/apexcode/): Server-side programming language and runtime for Salesforce custom logic.
- [Visualforce Developer Guide](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.pages.meta/pages/): Framework for building custom user interfaces on the platform.
- [SOQL and SOSL Reference](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.soql_sosl.meta/soql_sosl/): Query language reference for retrieving Salesforce records and search results.
- [Flow Builder](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.flow.htm&type=5): Documentation for declarative workflow automation and process orchestration.
- [Einstein for Developers](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/einstein): Developer resources for AI features and intelligent application experiences.

## SDKs and Integration Tools
- [Mobile SDK](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/mobile): SDKs and guides for building Salesforce-connected mobile applications.
- [Slack Platform](https://api.slack.com/): Developer platform for Slack apps, automation, and integrations within Salesforce.
- [MuleSoft Developers](https://developer.mulesoft.com/): Integration and API development resources for MuleSoft and Anypoint Platform.
- [Tableau Developers](https://developer.tableau.com/): APIs and developer tools for Tableau analytics and embedded experiences.
- [Heroku Dev Center](https://devcenter.heroku.com/): Documentation for cloud app deployment, operations, and platform services.
- [AppExchange](https://appexchange.salesforce.com/): Marketplace for Salesforce apps, components, consultants, and partner solutions.

## Learning and Training
- [Trailhead](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/): Interactive learning platform for Salesforce products, roles, and technical skills.
- [Trails](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/trails): Curated learning paths for Salesforce roles, products, and certifications.
- [Modules](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/modules): Self-paced units covering Salesforce concepts, features, and best practices.
- [Projects](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/projects): Hands-on guided projects for building practical Salesforce skills.
- [Superbadges](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/content/learn/superbadges): Scenario-based credentials validating applied Salesforce expertise.
- [Certification](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/credentials): Official Salesforce certification and credential information.

## Trust, Security, and Compliance

- [Privacy Information](https://www.salesforce.com/company/privacy/): Privacy policies, data handling practices, and related disclosures.
- [Compliance](https://www.salesforce.com/company/legal/compliance/): Compliance programs, certifications, and regulatory information.
- [Responsible AI](https://www.salesforce.com/ai/responsible-ai/): Principles and practices for trusted, safe, and ethical AI.
- [Legal](https://www.salesforce.com/company/legal/): Legal terms, policies, notices, and contractual resources.
